summary: The production rootless runner binds a public Git snapshot read-only at /source and runs the fixed container UID32768. Creating/extracting the snapshot under caller umask077 can remove non-owner traversal/read permissions even when every Git blob and image identity is correct. The runner now derives public directories0755 and regular files0644/0755 from validated Git executable classes, while enclosing state/execution directories remain0700 and output ownership is unchanged. It validates the complete extracted population before chmod, then applies modes through held Linux directory-relative descriptors with no-follow/nonblocking opens and descriptor type/link checks. Symlink, special-file, foreign, missing and escaped paths refuse before launch. The actual RunAsync regression uses real tar under a child-local077 mask, validates bytes/executable classes and private parents at the inert Podman create port, and exercises refusal shapes. These source/fixture assertions do not establish successful execution as the actual container UID, a whole image/P2 qualification, installed adoption or authority to retry a failed operation. Preserve original failed receipts and separately admit the genuine consumer route.
title: Private caller umask must not hide a public Git snapshot from the fixed container user
